evidence_scope: Sanitized public summary of one completed task-owned workflow run. Raw logs, storage locations, run configuration, and model weights remain private.

workflow.execution: Completed through the generic Workbench workflow submit path. The private invocation supplied only run-owned storage and recovery overrides; no live identifiers are published here.

data.split: contiguous tail: 64 train episodes / 16 held-out episodes

modality_mapping.decoder: decord with a documented H.264 derivative

data.normalization: Native min/max statistics frozen from the training split only; predictions inverse-transformed before metrics.

training.recovery_lineage: The completed full-pass candidate was retained from the same task-owned workflow recovery lineage after an earlier evaluation defect, then reloaded for the complete held-out evaluation and publication. It was not duplicated as a second training allocation.
training.sampler: native Trainer random sampler without replacement per epoch

runtime.device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

held_out_offline_comparison.inference: One native baseline and candidate get_action call per recorded observation, using the same per-frame diffusion seed 1701.
held_out_offline_comparison.action_coordinates: Raw source dataset coordinates; physical units are not declared by source metadata.

video.independent_inspection: Frames 0, 60, and 119 were decoded and visually checked. They show public recorded front/wrist observations, recorded action targets, and baseline/candidate offline prediction curves. The overlay explicitly says that this is not a rollout.

durable_artifacts.published_html_is: The pipeline-generated self-contained HTML plus this factual training-evidence section; the exact pipeline HTML hash above remains the durable artifact identity.

review_history.note: The one historical Claude Code review did not review this workflow/proof head. See claude-review-disposition.json.

limitations: Recorded observation video is an offline input, not a generated policy rollout; no predicted next states or robot motion are shown.
No simulator or physical-robot evaluation was performed or claimed; a simulator was not required for this offline learning inspection.
Lower held-out action error does not establish robot success, safety, deployment readiness, reward discrimination, or real-world policy improvement.
No outcomes, success/failure labels, measured progress, or synthetic label perturbations were used.
